2d.note: 0 of the 58 search-stage misses were categorized rescue_by='alt-names' -- no miss in this slice was fixable purely by searching an in-sentence parenthetical alternate name; every rescuable miss required the stronger label-guess mode (oracle knowledge of the canonical Wikidata ru-label, e.g. Апис for surface 'быку', Держава Ахеменидов for 'Персией'). 5 misses are metric artifacts, not real search failures: 4 are gold_qid pointing at the wrong real-world referent while the correct entity was already returned as a candidate ('already-hit-in-reality'), 1 (скифского «звериного стиля», Q131802) is a mis-annotated gold pointing to the wrong QID (Q1092377 is the correct target and is the sole hit for the exact phrase, but no candidates were returned under Q131802). If gold were corrected for all 5, the ceiling candidates_hit would be 284+52+5=341/358 (95.3%). Exactly 1 search-stage miss remains genuinely irreducible even under oracle label-guess: Q12087706 'ванов' (Академия Цзися) -- gold ru label is the bare title 'Ван', a literal homograph shared by several unrelated Wikidata items (Vannes, Van/Turkey, etc.); label-guess reproduces the identical query as the original surface search and still ranks gold 17th/20, past any reasonable candidate cutoff.
